description: Test specifications for browser verification features in a Playwright-based testing framework, including element visibility, text presence, list content, and value assertions.

methods.description: Test for verifying visibility of elements identified by role and accessible name.

methods.description: Test for verifying behavior when an element is not found.

methods.description: Test for handling cases where specific text is absent.
